title: Compatibility editor crashes on Intel/NVIDIA hybrid system; disabling Vulkan driver discovery avoids the crash
body:
### Tested versions

4.7.2.stable.gentoo.ed1daf0bf
Full commit: ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079
Gentoo-packaged build. An official Godot binary has not yet been tested.

### System information

Gentoo Linux, kernel 7.1.3-gentoo-dist-bin

### Issue description

Detailed system info: 
- Gentoo Linux, kernel 7.1.3-gentoo-dist-bin
- Wayland, Hyprland
- Renderer: Compatibility / OpenGL
- Intel UHD Graphics 630, kernel driver i915
- NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 Mobile, proprietary driver 580.173.02
- Mesa 26.2.4; also reproduced with 26.2.1
- Vulkan loader 1.4.350.0
Mesa is built with Intel OpenGL support but without the vulkan USE flag. The only installed Vulkan ICD manifest is nvidia_icd.json.


The Godot editor crashes during startup with an empty Compatibility project containing only project.godot. No scripts, scenes, plugins or GDExtensions are required.
The crash reproduces on native Wayland. It also reproduces under Xvfb with Mesa software OpenGL rendering.
The logs show the OpenGL renderer initializing on Intel, followed by Vulkan device discovery listing the NVIDIA GPU. Texture/render-target errors and shader compilation failures then occur, followed by a native crash reported as signal 11.
Disabling Vulkan driver discovery for the Godot process only avoids the observed crash. This suggests an interaction with Vulkan initialization, but I have not established the underlying cause.

### Steps to reproduce


1. Extract the attached minimal project, or create a directory containing this project.godot:
```godot
config_version=5

[application]
config/name="Editor startup control"

[rendering]
renderer/rendering_method="gl_compatibility"
```

2. From that directory, run:
```bash
godot --editor --path . \
  --display-driver wayland \
  --rendering-driver opengl3 \
  --audio-driver Dummy \
  --verbose
```

3. Observe the native crash during editor startup.
This was also reproduced with fresh, isolated XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME and XDG_CACHE_HOME directories, excluding existing user editor settings as a requirement.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

- minimal project: [godot-editor-crash-minimal-20261016.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33523966/godot-editor-crash-minimal-20261016.zip)
- latest void engineering reproduction logs and retrospective: [vssjx-editor-issue-repro.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33523996/vssjx-editor-issue-repro.log)
- original project crash log: [vssjx-editor-wayland.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33524008/vssjx-editor-wayland.log)
- bypass method test log: [vssjx-editor-user-preferences.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33524014/vssjx-editor-user-preferences.log)
